## Proposed change
This is a fix for the new overkiz DHWP (introduced in 2022.12) for the operation list.
This is related to [this comment](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/83326#issuecomment-1345566762) when I figured out I created the operation_list the wrong way.

The code here now create the operation list in reverse side in order to make use it when sending command to Overkiz when changing the status.
I update the code to handle the no state case in the same loop to avoid having 2 times the same loop.

review_comments: Would it make more sense to pull this logic out to the `operation_list` property instead of dynamically setting the internal static attribute on initialization? That's how I've seen it done in other entities which have a property that changes based on the device.

@kevin-brown I'm not sure to understand how I'm supposed to do that.  
Could you point me to an exemple in the code please?
Since the operation list is constant after initialization we prefer using an instance attribute over a property.

> Since the operation list is constant after initialization we prefer using an instance attribute over a property.

That's fair, I can get behind that differentiation here.

You can keep this, even if there is values you don’t want. So we still have similar code with other climate entisies.
But can keep your logic around `_attr_operation_list`.

it's never used, it will add confusion against the other custom variables.
I'll have a mypy alert saying this var is not used I think.

I would prefer having "not used everywhere const" into a const file.

I think that's not too bad if this reversed dict isn't here.
The constant is not used now, but if you mimic the other climate entities it should be.

It could not work like other devices.  

If the regular reverse const is used in `async_set_operation_mode` this means that all DHWP who want to use the preset to `STATE_ECO` will set the `OverkizCommandParam.AUTO_MODE` to overkiz.  
But... some devices don't support this specific mode, and are requiring `OverkizCommandParam.AUTO`.

So this constant won't be used anywhere, and will be a source of bug IMHO.
